As per order dated 02.11.2017 of the Director (RCD), all States and Union Territories are directed not to launch prosecutions for non-conformance of limit of iron filings in cases where samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016.
They are also advised to withdraw all such prosecutions launched prior to 19.05.2016 either under FSS Act, 2006 or PFA Act, 1954.
In this case, prosecution has been launched for non-conformance of iron fillings in the year 2015.
Matters being so, prosecution in these cases will not lie in view of the aforesaid order dated 02.11.2017.

In the result, this Crl.M.C. is allowed, and all further proceedings against the petitioners in CC.No.1398/2016 of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court, Vaikom, based on Annexure-A complaint, are hereby quashed.
